title: Qui-Gon Jinn's Aethersprite
subtitle: Guided by the Force
text: On Attack: The next time you use a “When Played” ability this phase, you may use that ability again.
rules:
Any ability whose trigger starts with "When played…" is considered a "When Played" ability.
Once it triggers, the Aethersprite's "On Attack" ability lets you reuse the next "When Played" ability you use even if it is defeated.
